The core data structure is a list of mesh objects.
**Scene Construction:** Assemble the list of triangular mesh objects.
**Transformation:** Apply model-view-projection transformations to the vertices of each triangle.
**Rasterization:** Determine which pixels are covered by each triangle.
**Shading:** Compute lighting for each pixel.
**Rendering:** Draw the triangles to the screen.
*   **Intersecting Surfaces:** When surfaces intersect, standard and grid engines may render them raggedly due to back-to-front drawing of triangles.
